source: Samsung Asset Management official KODEX product pages, historical portfolio deposit file views
timing_rule: A snapshot observed after its as-of-date close may first drive an order at the next trading-session open.

coverage.note: Each official top-30 table includes one KRW cash/deposit row; normalized files retain the 29 six-digit equity rows.

limitations: ETF membership is a point-in-time proxy for the provider's factor methodology, not the underlying raw accounting fields.
The public product-page table exposes only its top 30 portfolio rows.
A strategy failing on development data must not inspect later snapshots for parameter selection.
